blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The motorist caught on video with his eight-year-old son kneeling while riding as a back rider on a motorcycle in Barangay Tawason voluntarily appeared before the Mandaue Traffic Enforcement Agency (TEAM) on Thursday, November 19, to explain his side. Rey Rosaceña met with TEAM head Hyll Retuya following the circulation of a video showing the child kneeling on the motorcycle while it was moving on Monday afternoon, November 16.
